pattern: では済まない（ではすまない）
purpose: Warn that a minor response or description will not be enough.
keywords: An apology alone will not settle this damage.
The repairs will cost more than ten thousand yen.
This time it probably will not end with a warning.
restrictions: The matter requires greater consequences, action, or cost.
mistake: The noun is the inadequate outcome, not the action required next.
